first_attack: Audit precise statement and prove a restricted case

claim_review_2026.primary_title: A torsion-free group algebra that is not directly finite
claim_review_2026.claimed_theorem: The constructed finitely presented torsion-free group is nonsofic; its group ring over F_2 is not directly finite.
claim_review_2026.scope_note: A finitely presented nonsofic group is countable and refutes the universal soficity conjecture. The claimed nonsoficity may follow from the direct-finiteness obstruction, but is not an independently checked example.
claim_review_2026.known_caveats: Shares one manuscript and underlying construction with M044; do not count these as two independent proof sources. Soficity inference depends on correct direct-finiteness obstruction and the sofic-group finiteness theorem. The upstream author-described Lean comparator does not assert that the group is nonsofic; that conclusion needs a separate mathematical audit.
